## Deprecated

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/deprecated/payments/v1/payment-create/): `intent` to `sale`, `authorize`, or `order`.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/deprecated/payments/v1/authorization-void/): AuthorizationBearer <token>
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/deprecated/payments/v1/capture-get/): AuthorizationBearer <token>
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/deprecated/payments/v1/capture-refund/): `amount` object. AuthorizationBearer <token>

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/deprecated/invoicing/v1/invoice-record-refund/): AuthorizationBearer <token>

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/deprecated/payments/v1/orders-void/): `PENDING` or `AUTHORIZED` states or those in the `CAPTURED` state that are not fully captured. AuthorizationBearer <token>

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/deprecated/payments/v1/sale-refund/): `amount` object in the JSON request body. For a partial refund, include an AuthorizationBearer <token>
